title: Up-and-Under Post Finish
description: A post player practises the up-and-under move — a shot fake followed by a step through — to finish against a defender who bites on the fake.

content.objective: Use a shot fake and step-through to finish once the defender commits to blocking the shot.
content.setup: A post player catches on the block with a defender playing tight behind them.
instructions: Catch and pivot to face the defender with the ball secure.
Shot fake convincingly, holding the fake for a real beat.
If the defender jumps or reaches, step through to the open side and finish.
If the defender stays down, pass back out or try a different move.
coachingPoints: Keep the fake low — a big, slow fake gives the defender time to recover.
Step through decisively once the defender commits.
Protect the ball with the body throughout the move.
commonMistakes: Fading away on the finish instead of stepping through strong.
Travelling by moving the pivot foot during the fake.
Finishing off the wrong foot for the angle of approach.
content.safety: Defender contests with hands up only, no early contact before the shot.
